notes: The reference CLI is pinned by version, not merely by name on PATH: XDR-JSON key spellings changed between releases. Releases before 28.0.0 emit the Rust keyword-escaped key 'type_' where SEP-0051 requires 'type'.

sdk_xdr_commit is the XDR pin this SDK generates from (tools/xdrgen-kt/xdr-source.cfg). It differs from xdr_commit, so the reference CLI cannot resolve types and enum members added after the commit it vendors. Those are reported as unresolvable rather than as mismatches.
